stdout:
scope: CPU-only identity, sibling-branch, duplicate-completion and authoritative-reference checks; no GPU or serving measurement
sibling_branches=2 same_token=True same_ordinal=True distinct_keys=True
edge_cases: empty_view=ok duplicate_row_rejected=True q0_rejected=True
negative_control_arrays_detected=True first_error=param mismatch at row 0
negative_control_synchronized_detected=True first_error=atom field mismatch at row 0
duplicate_completion: output_once=True rng_once=True holders_once=True
late_result: stale_business_discarded=True exec_ref_consumed_once=True
all_checks=PASS

sandbox.filesystem: private root; read-only public inputs and Python runtime; writable /out and tmpfs
